cases.sentence: Его мучила предстоящая необходимость вмешаться в эти ___ хозяйства, для которых мать вызвала его.
cases.explain: «глупые дела» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: After reaching home Nikoláy was at first serious and even dull. He was worried by the impending necessity of interfering in the stupid business matters for which his mother had called him home. To throw off this burden as quickly as possible, on the third day after his arrival he went, angry and scowling and without answering questions as to where he was going, to Mítenka’s lodge and demanded an account of everything. But what an account of everything might be Nikoláy knew even less than the frightened and bewildered Mítenka. The conversation and the examination of the accounts with Mítenka did not last long. The village elder, a peasant delegate, and the village clerk, who were waiting in the passage, heard with fear and delight first the young count’s voice roaring and snapping and rising louder and louder, and then words of abuse, dreadful words, ejaculated one after the other.

cases.explain: «многие жители» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: (This shrubbery was a well-known haven of refuge for culprits at Otrádnoe. Mítenka himself, returning tipsy from the town, used to hide there, and many of the residents at Otrádnoe, hiding from Mítenka, knew of its protective qualities.)

cases.translation: “No, my dear boy” (the count, too, felt embarrassed. He knew he had mismanaged his wife’s property and was to blame toward his children, but he did not know how to remedy it). “No, I beg you to attend to the business. I am old. I …”

cases.sentence: После этого молодой Ростов, уже не вступаясь более ни в какие дела, с ___ занялся еще новыми для него делами псовой охоты, которая в больших размерах была заведена у старого графа.
cases.explain: «страстным увлечением» — after the preposition «с», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: “This,” answered Nikoláy. “You say it rests with me. Well, I don’t like Anna Mikháylovna and I don’t like Borís, but they were our friends and poor. Well then, this!” and he tore up the note, and by so doing caused the old countess to weep tears of joy. After that, young Rostóv took no further part in any business affairs, but devoted himself with passionate enthusiasm to what was to him a new pursuit—the chase—for which his father kept a large establishment.
